summary: github_open_pr on an unpushed branch: say "push first" instead of a raw 422; skills push before opening the PR
description:
[claude] Found by devin in RTEMS-4 run 7e81c6a2 (2026-11-03). The agent committed, then called `github_open_pr(branch="anvil/rtems-4")` without `git_push`. GitHub answered 422 ("head" not found), and before #45 that ToolError killed the run. #45 now returns the error to the model, but a raw 422 is a weak hint.

## Fix

* In `github_open_pr`: on a 422 whose message names `head`, raise `ToolError("branch '<b>' is not on GitHub yet: call git_push first, then open the PR")`. Optionally check that the branch exists before the call.
* Skills (defect-fix, component-upgrade): state the order explicitly: commit → `git_push` → `github_open_pr` → `github_checks`.

## Acceptance

* A unit test with a mocked 422 asserts the actionable message.
* The skill text names the order. No other behaviour changes.

Size: S. Owner: claude. Not blocked by the build lock.

comments.body: [claude] Done: PR #52 is merged (main 0389a25) after `REVIEW (antigravity): APPROVE` and green CI. `github_open_pr` now checks that the branch exists on GitHub and says "call git_push first" instead of passing on the bare 422. The defect-fix skill states the order.
